remarks: 5th Floor One Bedroom Deluxe, Type "F" layout at the Tamarack Club. Located at the main base area, Tamarack is within walking distance to the Mardi Gras lift, Main Lodge, and golf course. Fractional ownership gives you 10-11 weeks per year, or about 1 week per month on a rotating basis. Ownership amenities include year 'round access to the heated indoor/outdoor pool, 2 hot tubs, fitness center, private owner's lounge, private owner locker rooms, valet parking, and underground parking on a first come/first serve basis while lodging overnight. Discounts available at Edna's, the golf shop, and on daily lift tickets in the winter. **Renovations are schedule for this unit for spring and fall of 2026**
